bodyHtml:
What This Is

280-fold reduction in AI inference costs since 2022 driven by hardware gains and architectural innovations, triggering Jevons rebound effect on total AI energy demand.. Achieved.

Early commercial products exist. Market is forming with limited but growing deployment. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

280-fold decline in inference costs since late 2022. Compute performance/watt increased ~34%/year since 2008. GPU generations delivering compounding gains. Allianz Research May 2026.

Status

  • Model Distillation
  • Speculative Decoding

What This Enables

  • AI Energy Rebound Effect

Investment Exposure
